papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
papers.authors: Lukas Knobel, Andrew Zisserman, Yuki M. Asano
papers.affiliations: Fundamental AI Lab, UTN; VGG, University of Oxford
papers.intro: 本文提出结构化动态模型（SDM），通过未来特征预测从冻结的预训练图像特征中显式分离出主要（primary）和残余（residual）运动成分，在少量弱监督下超越基于冻结特征的基线，并在多个任务上匹敌强监督方法。

papers.title: Scene Parameter Saliency via Differentiable Light Transport
papers.authors: Linas Beresna, Eugene Fiume
papers.intro: 论文提出通过可微渲染器对标量指标进行反向传播，得到场景参数的梯度，并将其作为“度量显著图”（metric saliency maps），以解释物理场景元素对图像指标的影响，从而将可微渲染从优化工具扩展为理解工具。

papers.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
papers.authors: Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Yitong Li, Shuchen Xue, Haozhe Liu, Jingyu Xin, Yuyang Zhao, Tian Ye, Zhangjie Wu, Zian Wang, Daquan Zhou, Ping Luo, Song Han, Enze Xie
papers.intro: SANA-Video 2.0提出一种混合线性-softmax注意力机制（Hybrid Linear-Softmax Attention）与块注意力残差（Block Attention Residuals, AttnRes）的视频扩散Transformer，在5B和14B规模下实现单GPU上720p视…

papers.title: ElasticTTT: Prior-Preserving Test-Time Tuning for Video Editing
papers.authors: Yueyi Liu, Chi Zhang, Sen Cui, Miao Liu
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
papers.intro: 本文提出ElasticTTT框架，通过目标分布正则化、对比CFG和异步噪声调度三个组件，在测试时微调过程中保留生成先验的弹性，系统性地解决先验崩溃，实现单样本视频编辑的最优性能。

papers.title: Achieving Text-based Person Retrieval with Any Granularity
papers.authors: Jialong Zuo, Hanyu Zhou, Dongyue Wu, Yongtai Deng, Mengdan Tan, Nong Sang, Changxin Gao, Xiang Bai
papers.affiliations: National Key Laboratory of Multispectral Information Intelligent Processing Technology, School of Artificial Intelligence and Automation, Huazhong University of Science and Technology（第一作者至第七作者）；School of Software Engineering, Huazhong University of Science and Technology（第八作者Xiang Bai）
papers.intro: 该论文提出了一种全新的“任意粒度文本人物检索”范式，通过构建多粒度数据集UFine6926-MG、多粒度评估基准MG-Eval以及跨模态多粒度对齐与匹配框架CMAM，系统解决了查询粒度不确定条件下的检索问题。

papers.title: PercepCap: Video Captioner with Structured Spatio-Temporal Perception
papers.authors: Yifan Xu, Zihao Wang, Zhixiao Wang, Jiaming Zhang, Yichun Yang, Desen Meng, Yuanxing Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Limin Wang
papers.tags: object detection, tracking, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University; Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology; Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: PercepCap提出一个感知感知的视频字幕框架，通过显式生成包含对象轨迹和时序事件的时空感知轨迹，再基于该轨迹生成最终字幕，并利用两阶段训练（PD-SFT和PG-RL）及字幕锚定感知数据构建来提升字幕质量。

papers.title: Persian Pixel: A large-scale synthetic OCR dataset for Persian language
papers.authors: Pouria Mahdi, Haq Nawaz Malik
papers.intro: 本文提出Persian Pixel——首个大规模、多粒度、开源授权的波斯语合成OCR数据集（343,000+图像-文本对），采用SynthOCR-Gen渲染管道忠实再现波斯文字特征，并通过25+种随机退化模型缩小合成到真实领域的差距，可直接用于微调TrOCR和Donut等现代Transformer …

papers.title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
papers.authors: Junhao Zhuang, Shiyi Zhang, Yuxuan Bian, Yaowei Li, Yawen Luo, Yijun Liu, Weiyang Jin, Songchun Zhang, Xianglong He, Xuying Zhang, Haoran Li, Haoyang Huang, Zeyue Xue, Nan Duan
papers.intro: 提出Self Gradient Forcing（SGF），一种两阶段训练策略，通过无梯度串行滚动记录状态，再并行重建退出步计算并恢复梯度流，在避免全串行反向传播的前提下为干净上下文KV写入提供未来损失监督，显著增强自回归视频扩散的长视频外推能力。

papers.title: PolySim: Deterministic Polynomial Surrogates for Cross-Modal Retrieval on CiM
papers.authors: Xinzhao Li, Charles Power, Pengyu Ren, Jongun Won, Likai Pei, Yuting Hu, Jinjun Xiong, Alptekin Vardar, Ningyuan Cao, Xiaobo Sharon Hu, Thomas Kämpfe, Kai Ni, Ruiyang Qin
papers.affiliations: 未明确（见第十二节作者机构逐条列出）
papers.intro: PolySim将概率高斯嵌入转化为确定性多项式系数向量，并采用可学习的阶双线性核计算相似度，使概率跨模态检索首次能够在标准CiM交叉阵列上以单步矩阵向量乘法的形式执行。

papers.title: Test-Time Training for Modality Order Consistency in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Aditi Gupta, Yossi Gandelsman
papers.affiliations: Aditi Gupta - University of Chicago; Yossi Gandelsman - Reve
papers.intro: 本文发现VLM对模态顺序存在电路级失效，提出一种不对称的测试时训练方法，以更强的一支（image-first）为教师，通过对齐弱支（question-first）的预测分布，在无标签情况下极大缩小顺序性能差距，同时略微提升强支自身的性能。

papers.title: Toward Reliable RGB-D Semantic Segmentation: Handling Missing Modalities via Condition Dropout
papers.authors: Xuchen Zhu, Yajuan Wei, Shuang Hao, Jiwei Jiang, Guanxiang Mao, Fang Ren
papers.affiliations: Xi’an University of Posts & Telecommunications (Xuchen Zhu, Yajuan Wei, Fang Ren), Xi’an Jiaotong University (Shuang Hao), Huazhong University of Science and Technology (Jiwei Jiang), Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (Guanxiang Mao)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种简单的持续训练范式Condition Dropout（ConD），通过冻结原始预训练RGB-D模型的编码器、复制一个可训练的辅助编码器，并采用零初始化特征注入和随机模态缺失输入策略，在不修改原架构和不从头训练的前提下，显著提升模型在单模态缺失下的鲁棒性，同时保持甚至略微提升完整模态下的精…

papers.title: Diverse-Intent Multi-Turn Fashion Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Mingqiang Tang, Haokun Wen, Meng Liu, Yupeng Hu, Weili Guan, Xuemeng Song
papers.affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology; Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen); Shandong University; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出了DIM-Fashion基准（26K多轮会话，覆盖7任务）和FashionAM框架（MLLM-VLP直接对齐查询与图库嵌入空间），首次实现了异构意图的多轮时尚图像检索，避免了文本化信息瓶颈。

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Models for Remote Sensing Image Understanding: Domain-Specific or General-Purpose?
papers.authors: Qiwei Ma, Chunping Qiu, Xinjun Cheng, Xiaoyu Zhang, Puhong Duan, Ke Yang, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, visual question answering, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hunan University (Ma, Duan, Kang, Li); Intelligent Game and Decision Lab (IGDL) (Qiu, Cheng, Zhang, Yang); Yuelushan Center for Industrial Innovation (Kang)
papers.intro: 该论文通过系统性综述和诊断性评估，表明通用CV-MLLMs在多个RSISU任务上可匹配甚至超越专用RS-MLLMs，揭示了当前MLLMs在空间推理、细粒度理解和指令泛化方面的局限性，并提出了可靠评估、高效部署和工具增强代理等未来方向。

papers.title: How Does Urban Context Relate to Residential Building Health? A Vision-POI Fusion Framework for Building-Level Housing Inspection
papers.authors: Kun Zhao, Helei Ren, Guilin Tang, Tianyi Chen, Zhehui Song, Xing Liu, Lijian Zhou, Yuhong Zhao, Xiang Gao, Jinming Jiang, Qichao Ban
papers.affiliations: School of Information Management, Qingdao University of Technology; Embodied AI & Robot Research Institute, Qingdao University of Technology; College of Architecture and Urban Planning, Qingdao University of Technology; Innovation Institute for Sustainable Maritime Architecture Research and Technology (iSMART), Qingdao University of Technology; Department of Urban Planning and Design, Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University
papers.intro: 本研究提出了一个视觉与POI（兴趣点）融合框架，通过多视图视觉聚合和POI上下文特征，评估老旧住宅建筑的健康状况，发现多视图聚合是性能提升的主要来源，而POI信息提供类别依赖的、有限的辅助增益。

papers.title: Vera: Identity-Faithful Human Subject-to-Video Generation
papers.authors: Yulong Xu, Xinyue Liu, Shujuan Li, huafeng shi, Yan Zhou, Jiwen Liu, Xintao Wang, Yu Shen Liu, Huaibo Huang
papers.affiliations: Kuaishou Technology, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: Vera通过构建百万级跨片段身份对齐数据集，并引入身份聚焦掩蔽监督（IFMS）和参考感知层级注意力（RALA），在单人和多人人类主体到视频生成中实现了高保真身份一致性、正确身份-角色绑定和自然运动。

papers.title: Not All Patches are Equal: Sampling Matters for Visible-Infrared Pre-Training
papers.authors: Qiwei Ma, Bin Deng, Junjie Zhu, Qiangjuan Huang, Puhong Duan, Ke Yang, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li
papers.affiliations: 未明确（但根据正文：Qiwei Ma, Bin Deng, Puhong Duan, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li - 湖南大学（Hunan University）；Junjie Zhu, Qiangjuan Huang, Ke Yang - 智能博弈与决策实验室（Intelligent Game and Decision Lab, Beijing））
papers.intro: 本文提出重要性感知采样（IAS）框架，从采样视角重新审视VIS-IR预训练，通过基于红外结构线索的patch权重、可学习采样模块和课程学习策略，实现按patch可靠性调整训练重点，显著提升下游任务性能。

papers.title: RS-RIE-Bench: Benchmarking Reasoning-Guided Remote Sensing Image Editing
papers.authors: Zihan Qin, Boao Xu, Zhao Dong, Yingping Sun, Ziheng Jiao, Junying Wang, Hongwei Wang
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University (Zihan Qin, Boao Xu, Hongwei Wang), Xi'an Modern Control Technology Research Institute (Zhao Dong), Lanzhou Institute of Physics (Yingping Sun), Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. (Ziheng Jiao), Fudan University and Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Junying Wang)
papers.intro: 本文提出了RS-RIE-Bench，首个面向推理引导遥感图像编辑的基准，包含486个样本，覆盖时间推理、因果推理和空间推理三类任务，采用三维评估协议（目标区域合理性、非目标区域保持性、图像质量一致性），对8个现有图像编辑模型进行系统评估，发现当前模型在严格联合满意标准下最高准确率仅24.28%。

papers.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
papers.authors: Santiram Tiwari, Nishant Sinha, Kunal Kislay
papers.affiliations: KGraph AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore, India – 560016
papers.intro: ChronoStitch提出一种免训练的两阶段视觉KV记忆合成方法：先通过三轴mRoPE增量旋转将独立存储的键重定位到全局时间-高度-宽度坐标系，再选择性重计算后续分块中偏差最大的少量视觉token以恢复缺失的跨块注意力，从而在不重新处理整个视频的前提下实现长时程时间推理。

papers.title: BLUE: Semantics-Preserving Video Compression for Efficient Vision-Language Surveillance Analytics
papers.authors: Shubham Baid, Akash James, Sahil Chachra, Nishant Sinha, Kunal Kislay
papers.affiliations: KGraph AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore, India – 560016
papers.intro: 论文提出并评估了一种面向固定摄像头监控视频的机器中心压缩方法 BLUE，它通过持久背景建模和前景保留，在保持 VLM 语义推理质量几乎不变的前提下，降低文件大小并利用跳帧型 P 帧信号减少 VLM 调用次数。

papers.title: Appearance Pointers -- Multimodal Region Control of Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Rahul Sajnani, Yulia Gryaditskaya, Radomír Měch, Srinath Sridhar, Matheus Gadelha
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.intro: 本文提出Appearance Pointers——一种紧凑的token表示，通过区域对应网络将文本或图像条件与用户指定的空间掩码对齐，引导扩散Transformer在正确位置使用正确外观线索，无需从头训练基础模型，首次实现模态无关的局部多模态控制。
